name: Jellyfin
description: Refreshes the Jellyfin libraries when a package finishes.

codes.jellyfin_notifier.setting.path_mapping.d: One line per folder: rDownloader's path=the path Jellyfin sees, e.g. /downloads=/data/media. The longest matching path decides and Jellyfin scans the folder that holds the package instead of every library; without a matching line every library is refreshed.
